## User Feedback
- [One question at a time](feedback_one_question_at_a_time.md) — ask scoping/clarification questions individually, not in batches
- [No enter-to-continue prompts](feedback_no_enter_prompts.md) — empty Enter doesn't work in Claude Code; require typed responses
- [Fetch discipline](feedback_fetch_discipline.md) — limit WebFetch to 3 sources, never block on slow fetches, skip and note failures
